gaps.sentence: He was the first climber ___ the summit without oxygen.
gaps.explanation: After 'the first/last/only + noun' a to-infinitive follows.

gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.
I remembered ___ the door, so I went back to check.
gaps.explanation: remember + -ing = recall a past action; remember to do = not forget a duty.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
The scheme aims ___ younger visitors to the museum.
gaps.explanation: aim + to-infinitive: aims to attract (aim at + -ing is also possible in BrE).

gaps.sentence: I'd prefer ___ at home rather than go out tonight.
gaps.explanation: 'Would prefer to do … rather than do'.

gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
